configurations.name: bzaro
configurations.//: autoPort is false because port 3000 is not incidental here. NEXT_PUBLIC_ROOT_DOMAIN is 'lvh.me:3000', and isRootHost() in src/lib/utils/url.ts compares the Host header against it by exact equality — so on any other port the apex stops being recognised and every tenant subdomain fails to resolve. AUTH_URL carries the port too, and since D25 that string decides whether session cookies are marked Secure.
